what_i_changed: Added pre-transport paging validation and regression coverage. `pages < 1` and `per_page` outside 1–100 raise ValueError; valid boundaries remain accepted. Verified: 330 passed, 3 skipped.
how_it_takes_the_required_approach: A private `_Paging` value object in the existing search module owns validation and is constructed before `collect` can enter its transport loop.
